#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text: Subject: Appointment of Shri Ajay Kumar Jaiswal, IRSME(2008) as CVO, NCL, Singrauli.

#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text: The Competent Authority has approved the appointment of Shri Ajay Kumar Jaiswal, IRSME(2008) as CVO, Northern Coalfields Ltd. (NCL), Singrauli under the Ministry of Coal with pay at level 13 (Rs. 1,23,100 – 2,15,900/-) of the pay matrix, for an initial period of 3 years from the date of assumption of charge of the post or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: Under Secretary to the Government of India

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text: 1. The Chairman, Railway Board, Ministry of Railways, Rail Bhawan, New Delhi with the request to relieve the officer immediately to take up his new assignment.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text: 2. The Secretary, Central Vigilance Commission, Satarkta Bhawan, GPO Complex, Block-A, INA, New Delhi-110023.

#/texts/17.label: paragraph
#/texts/17.full_gt_text: 3. Shri Ajay Kumar Jaiswal, IRSME(2008) through the Chairman, Railway Board, Ministry of Railways.

#/texts/18.label: paragraph
#/texts/18.full_gt_text: 4. PS to MOS(PP)/ PSO to Secretary(P)/ PPS to EO/ Dir(SM)/ DS(MM).
